text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —You always...
(Waaaaahhh—...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Like a shooting star.
Aiming for what lies beyond speed, beyond strength,
she dashed forward as if diving straight in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just watching sent shivers down my spine.
I admired them. I wanted to surpass them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Your radiance is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even in a sky full of countless shining stars,
she appeared as a peerless existence, like the North Star.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I saw it.

A few days after summer camp began,
a certain piece of breaking news came in.

"‘The Monster’ Narita Brian to Return!
Announces Entry in Tenno Sho (Autumn)"

text_block_list.name: Visitor in Swimsuit A
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!
That's Brian for you!"

text_block_list.name: Visitor in Swimsuit B
text_block_list.text: It was totally worth the wait! We HAVE to go see her comeback race this autumn!!

I can feel the crowd's infectious joy erupting at the sudden good news.
Amidst it all—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
Would you like to come watch again sometime this summer?
Brian-chan, that is."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...There's something I'm a bit curious about.

What Sakura Laurel said
kept nagging at the back of my mind.
choice_data_list: So we're here to watch Brian train...

text_block_list.text:
"...Let's wrap up today's training
a bit early."

And so, after training,
we decided to go observe Sakura Laurel and Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Whew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Rrrrraaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Brian Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...! *sigh*~
Lady Brian is simply incredible...

text_block_list.name: Brian Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I wish autumn would hurry up and get here.
Now that my injury's all healed up and everything...
The people around let out contented sighs as they speak in hushed tones about her running.
choice_data_list: (It seems she's unconsciously feeling the pressure too.)
(Seems she's unconsciously feeling the pressure too.)

text_block_list.text:
For a "tune-up" run after returning from injury,
that running is far too overwhelming in its intensity.

Once she reaches her complete form,
just what kind of running will she show us?
choice_data_list: It looks like your form is still being adjusted, though...

text_block_list.text:
It is burned into my mind even now.
That low center of gravity sinking toward the ground,
cutting through the wind like a gliding bird of prey.

"If she's regained that unique form of hers,
Narita Brian will be utterly unstoppable."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
You think so too, don't you, Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Brian-chan's form
is different from before...!
choice_data_list: Still, I'm sure they'll make adjustments right away.

text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is still fresh out of rehab.
She probably hasn't even shown half of her true strength.
choice_data_list: Once you get serious, it won't take you long, Brian.
Once you get serious, it won't take you long, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Still, to me, it has always looked like Brian-chan was running with everything she had."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It looked as though she was struggling
to take something back..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: When I look at it, I somehow get scared...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Ngh, what is this?
It might just be my imagination, though!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...When it felt like my legs were about to break,
a cold chill ran straight down my spine."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A similar feeling comes over me.
Whenever I watch that girl run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...However, what's broken can never truly return to the way it was.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Once broken, time can never be turned back.
The price must be paid."
...Suddenly, a worst-case scenario crossed my mind.

However, if that's the case, Narita Brian isn't
on her way back, but—
choice_data_list: Are you saying you can never go back to running like that...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! That is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Something like that...
Sakura Laurel stood silently on the beach for a while.
...Narita Brian is still running.
Desperately... as if trying to escape from here.

text_block_list.name: Brian Fan C
text_block_list.text:
We should clear out soon too.
If we stay until night, we'll just be a
nuisance to the academy staff.

text_block_list.name: Brian Fan B
text_block_list.text: Let's do that. Man, I'm really looking forward to the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...To everyone else, it looks like Brian-chan hasn't changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I think it can't be helped.
After all, her presence and overwhelming aura haven't changed one bit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because neither the greed nor the thirst for victory
has changed at all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
May I stay here and watch a little longer?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I understand full well that she doesn't want anyone trying to get close to her.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I want to be here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Her situation and mine are different.
Even so, I can imagine
just how painful it must be."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Impatience, frustration, and pain.
And――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...And the despair, too.
The setting sun slowly sinks below the horizon. Nighttime will be here before long.
Even so, none of them could tear themselves away from the beach where Narita Brian was.
